# Driving the counter of `counter.rtl` from the command session: watch the
# reset, stop the run when the count reaches three, poke the count and let
# the design run to `$finish`.
design counter.rtl

> time
time = 0
> where
counter_tb (module counter_tb) at time 0, running
> scope
scope = counter_tb
> watch rst
watching counter_tb.rst
> break q 8'd3
breakpoint 0 on counter_tb.q = 8'h03
> run
0: counter_tb.rst = 1'h1
12000: counter_tb.rst = 1'h0
breakpoint 0 on counter_tb.q = 8'h03
stopped at time 35000
> print q
counter_tb.q = 8'h03
> time
time = 35000
> delete
deleted 1 breakpoints
> force q 8'd200
forced counter_tb.q = 8'hc8
> print counter_tb.q
counter_tb.q = 8'hc8
> release q
released counter_tb.q
> dump on
dump on
> step
stepped to time 40000
> print nowhere
! unknown net `nowhere`
> frobnicate
! unknown command `frobnicate`; `help` lists them
> run
finished at time 112000
> dump off
dump off
> where
counter_tb (module counter_tb) at time 112000, finished
> quit
quit
